$ hemma update service dash --bogus
exit: 2
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
flag provided but not defined: -bogus
Usage of update:
  -H string
    	alias for --host
  -auth
    	shorthand for --auth-mode forward (--auth=false clears)
  -auth-groups string
    	comma-separated auth provider groups ('' clears)
  -auth-mode string
    	auth mode: forward|oidc|external|none
  -auth-policy-local string
    	auth requirement for local-horizon requests ('' clears): bypass|one_factor|two_factor|deny
  -auth-policy-public string
    	auth requirement for public-horizon requests ('' clears): bypass|one_factor|two_factor|deny
  -b string
    	alias for --backend
  -backend string
    	reverse_proxy upstream name:port
  -bypass-paths string
    	comma-separated request paths exempted from the auth gate ('' clears; forward mode only)
  -f string
    	alias for --fqdn
  -fqdn string
    	service fqdn
  -host string
    	host that runs the service
  -public
    	pre-rename alias for --tunnel
  -tunnel
    	generate a cloudflared tunnel ingress entry ('--tunnel=false' opts back out)
--- files ---
